book_title: Thinking In Time: The Uses Of History For Decision Makers
author: Richard E. Neustadt
book_description: "A convincing case that careful analysis of the history, issues, individuals, and institutions can lead to better decisions--in business as well as in government" (BusinessWeek).Two noted professors offer easily remembered rules for using history effectively in day-to-day management of governmental and corporate affairs to avoid costly blunders.
